recognize_zh: 三個漿細胞核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀（clock-face），細胞質淡藍並含細長針狀結晶（類 Auer 小體），背景也散佈游離的棒狀結晶，提示漿細胞骨髓瘤伴結晶性包涵體。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and coarse clock-face chromatin
Moderate blue-gray cytoplasm with pale perinuclear zones
Slender needle-like, rod-shaped crystalline inclusions within the cytoplasm
Numerous free rod-like crystals scattered in the background
Background red cells without rouleaux in this thin area
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clock-face chromatin and moderate blue-gray cytoplasm. Several of these plasma cells contain slender, needle-shaped Auer-rod-like crystalline inclusions, and similar free crystals are scattered in the background, likely released from disrupted cells. No blasts are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with intracytoplasmic crystalline inclusions; correlation with plasma cell quantitation, light-chain restriction and assessment for light-chain proximal tubulopathy (Fanconi syndrome) is recommended.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: Auer rods are found in blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO positive, not in cells with clock-face plasma-cell chromatin.
Crystal-storing histiocytes have abundant cytoplasm and small bland nuclei and are CD68/CD163 positive rather than CD138 positive.
Reactive plasma cells lack crystalline inclusions and are polytypic for kappa and lambda.
Stain precipitate lies on top of cells and the slide in random planes, whereas true crystals are consistently intracytoplasmic and uniform in shape.
